users.subtitle: Staff accounts, roles and access
users.protectedNote: Only a super administrator can manage this account

form.usernameHint: 3-30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot or underscore. Cannot be changed later.
form.deptHint: Required for doctors. It decides the consultation fee and who sees the doctor.
form.roleChangeWarn: Changing the role removes this user's custom permission overrides.
form.selfRole: You cannot change your own role.

form.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Ethiopian phone number

confirm.deactivateMsg: {{name}} will no longer be able to sign in. Their records are kept. This takes effect immediately.
confirm.activateMsg: {{name}} will be able to sign in again.
confirm.resetMsg: A new temporary password will be created for {{name}}. Their current password and active sessions stop working, and they must choose a new password at the next sign-in.

temp.title: Temporary password
temp.intro: Give this password to the user in person or by phone. It is shown only once and is not stored anywhere readable.
temp.warn: The user must change it at the first sign-in.

perm.title: Permission overrides
perm.intro: Add or remove single permissions for this person only. Everything else follows the role. Changing the user's role clears the overrides.
perm.privileged: Administrators with this role already have every permission.

roles.subtitle: What each role may do. Changes apply at the user's next request.
roles.readOnly: You can view the permissions but only a super administrator can change them.
roles.superLocked: The super administrator role is fixed and cannot be edited here.
roles.dashLocked: Every role keeps access to its dashboard.
roles.appliesTo: Saving applies immediately to {{n}} user(s) with this role.
roles.discard: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?

form.keyHint: 3-40 characters: lowercase letters, digits or underscore. Cannot be changed later.
form.name: Role name
form.keyInvalid: Use 3-40 lowercase letters, digits or underscore, starting with a letter

roles.deleteMsg: Delete the role "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
roles.deleteBlocked: This role is assigned to users. Move them to another role first.
roles.customNote: Custom roles get the generic dashboard (no charts), and are not offered as doctors in appointment booking.

audit.subtitle: Who did what and when. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.hidden: Details are hidden for your role (clinical information).
audit.rangeError: The start date must not be after the end date

settings.subtitle: Hospital identity and system defaults

settings.languageHint: Used for people who have not picked a language themselves.
settings.mrnHint: Applies to patients registered from now on. Existing numbers do not change.
settings.slotHint: Applies to new bookings. Existing appointments keep their times.
